scientific_integrity: Analytic principal-angle and positive-semidefinite proof; exact rational finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional real Euclidean subspaces and full-space one-step norm, Friedrichs cosine strictly between zero and one. Published 2014 spectral optimum is cited as prior work. A potentially relevant projected-relaxation paper was inspected only at abstract level; independent novelty confirmation is not implied.
title: Sharp one-step safety frontier and angle-dependent transient expansion for relaxed alternating projections
